search_scope: Existing evidence/registry reuse, then one deep candidate: official nats-py 2.15.0 PyPI wheel, official GitHub tag, wheel license and JetStream ACK APIs.

candidate.name: nats-py
candidate.maintenance_evidence: Official v2.15.0 release and signed GitHub release are present.

expected: handoff(JOB,ROOT) -> receive(JOB,ROOT) -> native receive ACK(JOB,ROOT) -> persistent/readable ACK -> TOOL016 read-back(JOB,ROOT,ACK), with no WIC-specific modification.

actual.publish_ack: JetStream publish() waits for PubAck containing stream, sequence and duplicate status.
actual.consumer_ack: Delivered JetStream messages expose ack(); ack_sync() waits for server processing of that consumer ACK.
actual.job_identity: Nats-Msg-Id supports publisher-side deduplication, but PubAck/consumer ACK does not natively return an immutable WIC JOB field end-to-end.
actual.root_identity: No native WIC ROOT field exists; ROOT must be encoded and mapped using application headers or payload.
actual.ack_readback: ack_sync() returns an immediate server response to the consumer; it does not create a persistent JOB/ROOT ACK record readable later by TOOL016.
actual.duplicate_loss: JetStream offers persistence, deduplication and redelivery controls, but WIC JOB/ROOT-to-ACK closed-loop persistence still requires integration code.

rejected_candidates.reason: ROUND_3: broker post-processing ACK and optional results backend do not implement native WIC receive-ACK read-back.
Native JetStream ACKs exist, but immutable WIC ROOT and persistent TOOL016-readable ACK require WIC-specific mapping/storage code.

next_search_condition: Externally complete product must natively preserve two caller-defined immutable correlation identities and expose a durable receive-ACK record queryable by the sender, without adapter, mapping or new result storage.
